integrity: The infinite statement is proved from the canonical threshold-block adjacency structure. Exhaustive finite computation through order 12 is used only as a stress test, not as a proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies minimum singleton power dominating sets on connected threshold graphs; it does not enumerate larger power dominating sets or propagation times. Full threshold-section text of the closest connected-power-domination paper was unavailable in the accessible public material, leaving a specific literature-overlap risk.
title: All minimum power dominating sets of connected threshold graphs
